The aromatic protons are represented by the peaks at 7.13, 7.39, and 7.90 ppm, confirming the presence of an aromatic ring. Given the carbonyl peak in the carbon NMR and the ethyl group, the compound could be an ester or amide with an aromatic ring. To further confirm the structure, I will use the IR spectra to identify functional groups, especially the carbonyl group.</thought>
